item_short_desc: Rothco’s Camo Playing Cards feature a sleek gloss finish on both sides and a woodland camo design, adding a tactical twist to your favorite card games. Each deck includes 52 cards and 2 jokers. Perfect for military enthusiasts and outdoor adventurers, these cards are built for durability and style.
